lessons.lesson: long sector beta can reproduce the whole anchor; a bottom-ranked negative control must be preregistered and must be able to falsify the ranking mechanism, not just lose to it
lessons.v3_consequence: control capable of separating mechanism from beta is a selection rubric gate

lessons.lesson: sidecar counted explicit CASH in turnover and accumulated cost twice; concentration evidence was wrongly UNAVAILABLE; corrected attribution reconciled at ~1e-15
lessons.v3_consequence: A2 repairs sidecar accounting; CASH excluded from tradable-leg turnover; every cost charged exactly once; zero-event/zero-position results cannot publish

lessons.lesson: raw percentage PnL is not incremental edge; both rejected families earned most of their return from market/sector drift
lessons.v3_consequence: incremental mechanism alpha defined separately from raw PnL; risk-matched SPY context and beta falsification required

lessons.lesson: fold-positive-share numbers were not reproducible under one consistent definition across families
lessons.v3_consequence: single fold-concentration definition: per-arm positive fold contribution / that arm's total positive fold contribution

lessons.lesson: crosscheck tolerance documented but never enforced in-runner; fail-closed applied post-hoc
lessons.v3_consequence: attribution tolerance enforcement point pinned in code with tests

lessons.lesson: freeze artifact self-referenced its parent commit; corrected post-hoc
lessons.v3_consequence: W1 freeze artifact records inputs and pins; the W1 SHA is declared by A1 after the freeze commit and pinned externally in control artifacts

lessons.lesson: issuer distributions vs provider adjust=all double-counted five 2025-12-05 splits; caught by independent data audit
lessons.v3_consequence: A3 revalidates corporate-action inputs and issuer-TR reconstruction before any scoring
